subject: Photofy onboarding: context window needs & hourly traffic estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Morgan <alicia@photofy.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Photofy onboarding: context window needs & hourly traffic estimate

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for taking the call last week. To kick off the implementation sizing and model shortlist work, we need a quick snapshot of the shape of traffic and the largest context you expect per request. That will let us recommend a starting model family and a conservative Dedicated configuration (or hosted routing profile) for the pilot.

Quick asks — can you confirm the following by EOD Monday if possible:  
- Typical prompt+response tokens per API call (avg) and a 95th percentile tokens per call if available  
- Expected steady-state QPS and a peak-hour multiplier (e.g., 3x)  
- Any multi-document context needs (e.g., conversation history, attachments to include) and desired context window (2k / 8k / 32k)  

Initial recommendations (rough):
- For light latency-sensitive UIs where 95th token length < 2k: Llama-2-chat-13B quantized (low cost)  
- If you need longer context (~8k) for conversation summaries: Mistral-Chat-8k / Llama-2-Chat-70B-q8 as a fallback (higher cost)  
- If you expect heavy embedding+generation mixes, we may separate embedding endpoints to avoid cross-workload interference

I attached a small token sampling template (photofy_token_sample.csv) — if you can drop a representative day of anonymized request payload sizes there, Monica and Ben will run a short sizing sweep and return a recommended shortlist and hourly bucket.

Next step after your numbers: Monica will draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with rollout milestones and Ben will propose initial Dedicated capacity / instance types for the pilot.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: photofy_token_sample.csv (CSV stub, columns: request_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, timestamp)
From: Alicia Morgan <alicia@photofy.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_g@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Photofy Platform Team <platform@photofy.io>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Photofy onboarding: context window needs & hourly traffic estimate

Hi Sean / Monica —

Thanks — attaching a small sample export (anonymized) of our production request sizes for last Thursday. High-level answers inline:  
- Avg tokens per call (prompt+response): ~420 tokens
- 95th percentile tokens per call: ~1,950 tokens
- Typical steady-state QPS: 0.6 requests/sec (approx 2,160 reqs/hour)
- Peak-hour multiplier: 4x (internally we see spikes during marketing pushes)
- Context: We include last 3 messages in the thread + image captions (text-only) — generally fits in an 8k window today; we may need 16k if we also include two prior documents during some flows

We want to keep latency under 500ms p50 for UI chat flows. Cost sensitivity: medium — we care more about responsiveness than absolute lowest cost for the pilot.

Let me know if you need a larger sample.

Best,
Alicia Morgan
Head of Product
Photofy

--
Attachment: photofy_token_sample.csv (anonymized sample, 200 rows)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Morgan <alicia@photofy.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean_g@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 12:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Photofy onboarding: context window needs & hourly traffic estimate

Alicia — great data, thanks. Quick synthesis and follow-ups:  

Synthesis (pilot sizing):
- Workload shape: steady ~2.1k req/hour, peaks up to ~8.6k req/hour (with 4x multiplier). Avg tokens ~420, 95th ~1.95k => plan for 2k+/request headroom.
- Context requirement: primary flows fit in 8k; select enterprise flows may need 16k.

Model shortlist (initial, prioritized by latency/cost):
1) Llama-2-Chat-13B-q4 (quantized): low cost, good latency for <2k windows — candidate for most UI flows
2) Mistral-Chat-8k (native 8k): balances cost and ability to handle the 95th percentile without truncation
3) Llama-2-Chat-70B-q8 (large, costlier): for the specific flows that require strong instruction-following with longer context — use as fallback via smart routing

Capacity recommendation (pilot — hosted/dedicated decision later):
- If Hosted: start with a two-node baseline using g5-class for redundancy and predictable p50 latency (autoscale on peaks)
- If Dedicated: reserve 1x high-memory GPU (A10G/A100L small carve depending on quantization) + a second spot/overflow pool to handle 3x short spikes; we can refine exact instance type after Ben runs kernel/runtime cost sims

Questions:
- For the 16k flows, are the documents binary attachments (images) you include text extracted from? Confirm whether the two-doc flow is common enough to justify 16k across the board or can be gated to a special route.
- Any compliance constraints around request retention or on-prem processing?

Next steps: Ben will run a short perf sweep (model latencies across 2k/8k/16k) using your sample tokens and return per-model p50/p95 and cost-per-1k-tokens. I’ll draft the MAP with target pilot dates and handoff tasks.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success / Implementation
Redwood Inference

Quick infra note and deliverables from my side:  

Infra plan (pilot):
- Perf sweep: I’ll run microbenchmarks for the three shortlisted models (13B-q4, Mistral-Chat-8k, 70B-q8) against three window sizes: 2k / 8k / 16k. Deliverable: CSV with p50/p95 latencies, token throughput, and estimated $/1k tokens (hosted-equivalent) by tomorrow EOD.
- Default kernel/runtime: use continuous-batching with a 20ms batch window for UI flows to preserve latency targets; increase batch window for background/async flows.
- For Dedicated: initial instance candidates: 1x A10G (quantized 13B) or 1x A100S/80GB if we need native FP16 for 70B variant. I’ll include cost delta and a recommended fallback route.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short model shortlist doc with the baseline p50 numbers from previous runs (redwood_model_shortlist.pdf). I’ll replace entries with Photofy-specific numbers after the sweep.

Next operational items:
- Monica: please confirm whether 16k should be gated to a separate route (that will reduce cost dramatically).
- Alicia: if you can flag which user flows require the two-doc context, we’ll prioritize those in the perf pass.

Ben Carter
Platform Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
